status.description: Reads the answer. Every other status arrives as an error body carrying recovery.

about.description: Judges fit before reading the whole guide: adopts it, or descends under a broader one.

matches.description: Reads what already stands for this domain; an empty list is the one thing that licenses a mint.

family.description: Reads the family this thing would be shelved in, as a specialist shop would.

domains.description: Sees how much of the tree already sits under it.

path.description: Reads it with `shopping_domain_get`, or descends from it.

name.description: Sees what this leaf already stands for before coining a second one.

paths.description: Adopts one of these, or coins a sibling leaf beside them.

tree.description: Places a new leaf where a specialist shop would shelve it, and sees that a setup of several things is several leaves: every standing path below the root, by family.
